title: Make a Database system for all created UIDs by Editor
body:
Closes: [#13328](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/13328)

This PR adds a UID creation database file to get the data of all created UIDs by editor. And saves it to project directory (`res://uid_database.cfg`).

Here is how UID Data Base looks like:

```
[UIDs]

"uid://c8trtvruq3i7n" = [
	{
		"type": "asset",
		"filename": "icon.svg",
		"path": "res://icon.svg",
		"created_on": "2025-12-12 (12:37:09) UTC",
		"created_on_ts": 1765543029,
		"uid_u64": 7129363633912858253
	}
],

"uid://d2l5etcdsyulp" = [
	{
		"type": "script",
		"filename": "test.gd",
		"path": "res://test.gd",
		"created_on": "2025-12-12 (12:37:09) UTC",
		"created_on_ts": 1765543029,
		"uid_u64": 9078898638754037269
	}
]
```

+
+class UIDDB {
+public:
+	static UIDDB *get_singleton();
+
+	// Create DB entry for UID. Path optional.
+	void record_uid(uint64_t p_uid, const String &p_path = String());
+	void ensure_db_dir();
+
+private:
+	UIDDB();
+	~UIDDB();
+
+	static String _utc_time_from_ts(int64_t p_ts);
+	static Dictionary build_normalized_dict(const Dictionary &src);
+	String _ext_to_type(const String &p_ext, const String &p_path) const;
+	void save_db();
+
+	String db_path = "res://uid_database.cfg";
+	HashMap<String, Variant> entries;
+	Mutex mutex;
+
+	static UIDDB *singleton;
+};
